records.name: Indian Institute of Space Science and Technology (IIST)
records.description: Indian Institute of Space Science and Technology (IIST) in Thiruvananthapuram is a deemed university under the Department of Space, Government of India, and is the only space technology university in Asia dedicated exclusively to space science and technology. It offers B.Tech., M.Tech., and Ph.D. programs in aerospace engineering, avionics, and physical sciences, with a direct pipeline to ISRO for placements. IIST students work on live ISRO projects as part of their education, making it India's most specialized institution for aspiring space engineers and scientists.

records.name: IIT Kharagpur (ECE)
records.description: IIT Kharagpur's Department of Electronics and Electrical Communication Engineering (ECE) is one of the oldest and most prestigious ECE departments in India, known for research in VLSI, communication networks, signal processing, and biomedical engineering. It offers B.Tech., M.Tech., and Ph.D. programs and is home to the Advanced Technology Development Centre (ATDC), working on cutting-edge communication systems. The department's alumni network spans the globe, with graduates in leadership positions at Apple, Google, Qualcomm, and ISRO.

records.name: IIT Delhi (Chemical)
records.description: IIT Delhi's Department of Chemical Engineering is a leading research and teaching department offering B.Tech., M.Tech., and Ph.D. programs with specializations in process systems engineering, catalysis, nanotechnology, and biochemical engineering. The department has strong industry collaborations with major chemical, oil & gas, and pharmaceutical companies and is home to the Centre for Energy Studies. IIT Delhi chemical engineering graduates are highly placed in refinery operations, specialty chemicals R&D, and process consulting roles.

records.name: Indian Institute of Petroleum Dehradun
records.description: Indian Institute of Petroleum (IIP) in Dehradun is a CSIR laboratory specializing in petroleum refining, petrochemicals, lubricant technology, and alternate fuels research. It offers Ph.D. programs through AcSIR and provides training programs for petroleum industry professionals through its Petroleum Research Institute. IIP has developed numerous refining processes and fuel formulations adopted by Indian refineries including IOCL, BPCL, and HPCL.

records.name: IIT Guwahati (Biotech)
records.description: IIT Guwahati's Department of Biosciences and Bioengineering is a leading biotechnology department in India offering B.Tech., M.Sc., M.Tech., and Ph.D. programs. The department has particular strengths in computational biology, drug design, biomaterials, and fermentation technology, and is associated with the Centre for the Environment. IIT Guwahati biotech graduates are well placed in pharmaceutical companies, biotech startups, and research institutions across the country.

records.name: Indian Institute of Management Calcutta
records.description: Indian Institute of Management Calcutta (IIM-C), established in 1961 as India's first IIM, is consistently ranked among the top two business schools in India and one of the best in Asia. It offers two-year MBA (PGDM), executive management, and doctoral programs and is known for its strong focus on quantitative methods, finance, and operations management. IIM Calcutta alumni are among the highest-paid MBAs in India and occupy top positions in global investment banks, consulting firms, and multinational corporations.

records.name: Indian Institute of Management Bangalore
records.description: Indian Institute of Management Bangalore (IIM-B) is one of India's premier business schools, established in 1973, consistently ranked in the top three IIMs nationally and among the top 50 globally. It offers PGDM (MBA), executive programs, and doctoral degrees with particular strengths in entrepreneurship, strategy, and general management. IIM-B's NSRCEL incubator is one of India's leading startup incubators, and the institute is closely connected with Bengaluru's vibrant tech and startup ecosystem.
